segments.source: Creates an asynchronous sequence that maps the given closure over the asynchronous sequence’s elements, omitting results that don’t return a value.
segments.ko: Creates an asynchronous sequence that maps the given closure over the asynchronous sequence’s elements, omitting results that don’t return a value.

segments.source:
```swift
@preconcurrency
func compactMap<ElementOfResult>(_ transform: @escaping (Self.Element) async -> ElementOfResult?) -> AsyncCompactMapSequence<Self, ElementOfResult>
```
segments.ko:
```swift
@preconcurrency
func compactMap<ElementOfResult>(_ transform: @escaping (Self.Element) async -> ElementOfResult?) -> AsyncCompactMapSequence<Self, ElementOfResult>
```

segments.source: An asynchronous sequence that contains, in order, the non-`nil` elements produced by the `transform` closure.
segments.ko: An asynchronous sequence that contains, in order, the non-`nil` elements produced by the `transform` closure.

segments.source: Use the `compactMap(_:)` method to transform every element received from a base asynchronous sequence, while also discarding any `nil` results from the closure.
segments.ko: Use the `compactMap(_:)` method to transform every element received from a base asynchronous sequence, while also discarding any `nil` results from the closure.

segments.source: Typically, you use this to transform from one type of element to another.
segments.ko: Typically, you use this to transform from one type of element to another.

segments.source: In this example, an asynchronous sequence called `Counter` produces `Int` values from `1` to `5`.
segments.ko: In this example, an asynchronous sequence called `Counter` produces `Int` values from `1` to `5`.

segments.source: The closure provided to the `compactMap(_:)` method takes each `Int` and looks up a corresponding `String` from a `romanNumeralDict` dictionary.
segments.ko: `compactMap(_:)` 메서드에 제공되는 클로저는 각 `Int`를 받아 `romanNumeralDict` 사전에서 해당하는 `String`을 조회합니다.

segments.source: Because there is no key for `4`, the closure returns `nil` in this case, which `compactMap(_:)` omits from the transformed asynchronous sequence.
segments.ko: `4`에 대한 키가 없기 때문에, 이 경우 클로저가 `nil`을 반환하고 `compactMap(_:)`는 변환된 비동기 시퀀스에서 이를 생략합니다.

segments.source: `transform`: A mapping closure.   accepts an element   of this sequence as its parameter and returns a transformed value of the   same or of a different type.
segments.ko: `transform`: 매핑 클로저입니다. 이 시퀀스의 요소를 매개변수로 받아 동일한 타입 또는 다른 타입으로 변환된 값을 반환합니다.
